question: Is the evaluation environment controlled and isolated from answers?
shown_means: the environment and its isolation described
checked_means: state clearing and isolation verified or enforced in code
applies_when: the benchmark runs systems in an environment with tools or state

applicability.reason: The benchmark runs systems in a repository with tools and state.

check.procedure: Auditor checks: (1) reading of the harness code, which starts a fresh container per evaluation and applies the hidden test patch only inside it; (2) for all 75 published SymPy images, listing of commits reachable beyond the base commit and files changed since it, with no network; (3) for the two images with non-ancestor commits, a search of those commits for the reference fix.
check.detection_limits: Covers the grading environment, not the environment a submitter gives its agent. The fix search matches added lines longer than 25 characters only. File mode changes in 22 images (no content change) were not examined further.

evidence.location: OpenAI, Introducing SWE-bench Verified (2024), https://openai.com/index/introducing-swe-bench-verified/, section SWE-bench Verified
evidence.quote: uses containerized Docker environments to make evaluating on SWE-bench easier and more reliable

evidence.location: OpenAI, Introducing SWE-bench Verified (2024), https://openai.com/index/introducing-swe-bench-verified/, section Background on SWE-bench
evidence.quote: The tests are not shown to the agent.

evidence.location: swebench 5.0.2, harness/run_evaluation.py, create_container docstring (line 79); the eval script that applies the hidden test patch runs inside that container
evidence.quote: Creates a container from an instance image for running evaluation.

evidence.location: OpenAI, Why SWE-bench Verified no longer measures frontier coding capabilities (2026), https://openai.com/index/why-we-no-longer-evaluate-swe-bench-verified/, section Background

reasons: The sources describe a containerized harness that hides the tests, and the auditor checks found no commit after the base commit other than the harness setup commit in 73 images; in the other 2, older release branch commits hold no line of the reference fix. The 2026 post reports environment dependent spurious failures, a limit on control rather than a leak of answers.
missing: Isolation of the agent's own environment is left to each submitter.

roles.author: Vitor Raposo
roles.assistant: Claude Code (Claude Opus 5.5) drafted this form from the cited sources and ran the listed auditor checks; the anchor is a proposal for the author, who reviews, changes if needed, and signs.

instructions: Record evidence locations with short quotes, the check performed, its outcome, detection limits, and reasons. The check outcome is the result of the check described in the procedure; state whether the benchmark sources report it or the auditor performed it. A rating without evidence and reasons is incomplete. Missing evidence is not a defect; a defect needs a cited location, and an oracle defect needs an executed counterexample.
